name: Mirza Khizr Sultan
role: Mughal prince associated with the Delhi phase of the 1857 uprising
contribution: He appears in historical accounts as one of Bahadur Shah II's sons who took part in the 1857 rebellion around Delhi, including its military mobilization phase.
context: Delhi and nearby North Indian theatres during the 1857-1858 anti-colonial uprising against East India Company rule.
impact: He is remembered in rebellion historiography as part of the Mughal wartime leadership circle that became a key target of British retribution after the fall of Delhi.
